name: Millstone Palm
description: Roll the palm in a slow grinding turn against the target's guard until the grains chew into it.

name: Grinding Stance
description: Stand with sand turning slowly under the soles so a pushing force is ground down before the legs.

name: Grind Step
description: Skid forward with a grating step that drags a ridge of sand behind the heel.

name: Mill Flick
description: Flick a spinning grain off the thumb so it grinds a shallow groove across the target.

name: Pestle Jab
description: Jab down onto the target's instep as if pounding in a mortar and break their step.

name: Grinding Disk
description: Spin a disk of hard sand against the target's guard and hold it there until the wearing slows their arms.

name: Crumble Fist
description: Strike one spot of the guard with sand that works into every crack and widens it.

name: Sand Trip
description: Let the ground under the foe's lead foot give so their advance stumbles while the user steps clear.

name: Sand Rake
description: Rake the fingers through a rising sheet of sand so it tears along the target's forearm.

name: Sand Skin
description: Let a layer of sand slide over the skin and move with every strike to blunt it.

name: Swell Step
description: Ride a low swell of sand that lifts the feet and moves the body a pace forward.

name: Sand Lash
description: Whip a thin ribbon of sand from the wrist that cracks against the target's cheek.

name: Ripple Reader
description: Watch the eddies in a sheet of sand underfoot and read the movements of anyone near it.

name: Sand Surge
description: Push a rolling wave of sand along the ground to knock a group of foes off their feet.

name: Sliding Sand
description: Turn the footing to loose slide so every foe in reach lurches and drops to a knee.

name: Veil Throw
description: Throw a pinch of fine dust that hangs in a veil before the target's eyes.

name: Sifted Guard
description: Hold a screen of sifted dust between the body and the foe that slows whatever passes through it.

name: Curtain Step
description: Step behind a falling veil of dust and appear again half a pace to the side.

name: Fine Pelt
description: Pelt the target with a tight burst of fine dust that stings every patch of bare skin.

name: Blinding Veil
description: Hang a thick veil of dust across the front so foes cannot track the user standing inside it.

name: Stifling Fall
description: Let a heavy fall of dust roll over the target's face and chest to dull breath and movement.

name: Abrasion Palm
description: Rub a palm of rough qi-sand across the target's arm and leave a raw band of wear.

name: Wear Guard
description: Turn a blow aside against a rough forearm that scuffs the striker's hand as it slides off.

name: Qi Rasp
description: Rub grit into the target's qi flow at the wrist so their next strike stutters.

name: Scrape Step
description: Scrape the sole along the ground and use the shed sand to push off into a quick pace.

name: Abrasion Sense
description: Run a palm near a target's clothing and feel which hidden objects wear against the cloth.

name: Dry Flick
description: Flick a dry grain from the fingertip that bites into the target's eyelid.

name: Wearing Grasp
description: Close a hand of gritty qi around the target's arm and wear at the muscle until it spasms.

name: Eroding Palm
description: Press a palm that sheds qi-sand into the target's qi shell and thins it with every breath.

name: Burnished Guard
description: Polish a skin of hard sand over both arms until blows glance away.

name: Cloud Seed
description: Seed the air before the foe with a pinch of dust that blooms into a small cloud.

name: Cloud Palm
description: Strike from inside a puff of dust so the palm arrives before the eye can find it.

name: Cloud Guard
description: Wear a close cloud of dust that thickens wherever a blow lands and softens its force.

name: Cloud Step
description: Leave a hanging puff behind and step out of it a pace away.

name: Dustcloud Read
description: Read the shape of every body in the cloud from the gaps they tear in the dust.

name: Rising Cloud
description: Raise a large cloud of dust that dims sight and sound for every foe caught in it.

name: Pressing Cloud
description: Press a dense cloud down onto one foe until its weight bows their back and shoulders.

name: Seep Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sheds fine sand to seep under the target's collar and cuffs.

name: Sand Seep
description: Let sand seep into the target's sleeves and boots until each limb feels heavy.

name: Trickle Step
description: Pour a thread of sand beneath the foot and ride the slide it makes for a pace.

name: Packed Sand
description: Compress sand over the chest and forearms until it holds as firm as a leather plate.

name: Seep Sense
description: Let a trickle of sand run across a floor and read where it pools and who stands near.

name: Trickle Flick
description: Flick a thin stream of sand from the fingers into the target's eyes.

name: Gap Thrust
description: Find a gap in the target's guard with a trickle of sand and push a stiff finger through it.

name: Filling Sand
description: Fill the space around the target's feet with fast-packing sand until they stand fixed to the knee.

name: Seeping Wave
description: Send a spreading skin of sand under a cluster of foes that works into boots and joints.

name: Seeking Sand
description: Follow the seams of the target's guard with seeping sand and strike where the gap opens.

name: Wearing Palm
description: Slide an open palm along the target's guard so the grit on it wears the cloth through.

name: Hand Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of hard sand from the fingertips across the forearms to catch short blows.

name: Worn Step
description: Take a smooth pace on a path of sand worn flat by the first footfall.

name: Hone Touch
description: Hone a hand against sand until its edge cuts through cloth and draws a thin line.

name: Wear Reader
description: Read the wear on a target's gear and learn how often and how hard they fight.

name: Sand Snap
description: Snap the wrist to throw a hard grain that cracks against the target's knuckles.

name: Gnawing Hand
description: Hold a hand of gnawing sand against a limb until the strength drains out of it.

name: Shed Guard
description: Shed a blow along the arm on a wave of sand that carries the strike past the shoulder.
